title: de-inline next: local validation and performance evidence

baseline_source_tree.contract: SHA256 over sorted root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/rust-toolchain.toml, each workspace crate Cargo.toml and src/**/*.rs; each relative UTF-8 path and file byte string is prefixed by its little-endian u64 byte length. Tests embedded in src are included.

candidate_source_tree.contract: SHA256 over sorted root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/rust-toolchain.toml, each workspace crate Cargo.toml and src/**/*.rs; each relative UTF-8 path and file byte string is prefixed by its little-endian u64 byte length. Tests embedded in src are included.

build.linker: GNU ld; the Rust bundled lld wrapper requires /proc/self/exe, which is unavailable here

host.interpretation: 1 and 4 denote requested decompiler worker threads. CPU affinity IDs were 2 and 2,3,4,5. Python reported logical_processors 1 or 4 inside those affinity masks. Physical core topology and CPU quota were not observed.

amplified_synthetic.description: Deterministic synthetic source from scripts/deinline_workloads.py. Every replica appends a print marker so whole-file deduplication cannot collapse payloads. This repeats five shapes; it is not 80 independent real-world programs.

semantic_fixtures.description: Every checked-in docs/failure_fixtures/semantic_roundtrip/*.luau compiled at O0, O1, O2 with -g1 and --fflags=false. Includes the new runtime regression witness. These are public regression fixtures, not the private Roblox corpus.

timing_contract.round_order: Even rounds baseline,next,reference; odd rounds reference,next,baseline. Each label has one untimed-for-summary warmup.
timing_contract.cache: Warm filesystem cache; per-label output directories reused. No explicit decompiler cache enabled.
timing_contract.timed_scope: Whole CLI process including startup, input decode, decompilation, formatting and output writes; harness polling overhead included. Input/output hashing is outside the timed interval.
timing_contract.aggregation: The original 15-round fixture/fourworker samples were short and showed a regression signal. A predeclared follow-up wrapped 8 sequential identical native CLI invocations in one monitored interval. Small-scope control similarly wraps 16 invocations. Wrapper generation is in reproduce.sh. Aggregate p95 is a batch p95, not an individual-call tail percentile.
timing_contract.percentile: Nearest-rank p95 equals the maximum for 15 samples.
timing_contract.contention: No concurrent Cargo builds, semantic/fuzz workloads or other benchmark workloads in this session during timing. External host scheduling/noise is not controlled.
timing_contract.rss: The default/proc RSS sampler was unavailable; its nulls are not zero-memory measurements. Separate native process RSS measurements are below.

peak_rss.method: Linux os.wait4 returns each child ru_maxrss in KiB; multiplied by 1024. Native binaries measured directly, separately from timing wrappers. Five fresh child processes per label/cohort/worker count, alternating label order, same affinities and reused output directories.

control.contract: Linux os.wait4 returns per-child ru_maxrss in KiB; multiplied by 1024. Includes process startup, decompiler, output I/O and allocator retention; no heap-allocation-count claim. Measured separately from interleaved timing samples.

typed_fuzz.meaning: Invalid mutated bytecode and fail-closed refusals are separate statuses, not counted as successful semantic comparisons.

semantic_validation.benchmark_vm_controls: passed v9/v12, nil arity, captures, methods, isolation, timeout and memory bound

candidate_rust_checks.counts: 1447 passed in the full workspace/all-targets no-fail-fast run plus 3 targeted integrations rerun successfully after zero-filled linker artifacts; those 3 were not previously counted as passed.
candidate_rust_checks.environment_cause: Missing /proc/self/exe prevents cache self-hashing and executable-locating subprocess tests; the same 12 tests fail on pristine baseline.

exhaustive_candidate_ablation.note: Separate feature run; overlaps tests in workspace total.

findings.amplified_synthetic: Whole-pipeline median time falls 19.62% with one worker and 22.12% with four workers versus baseline. Exhaustive-reference ablation largely removes this benefit.
findings.small_scope: Longer small-scope batches differ+0.262% in median from baseline; no material fallback regression observed.
findings.semantic_fixtures: One-worker native median differs +2.054%. Initial short fourworker samples differ+12.671%; longer eight-invocation batches differ+0.360% and batch p95 is lower. The short-sample regression signal did not reproduce with longer samples; both sets are preserved.
findings.memory: Median native process RSS is within +0.25% for fixture cohorts and lower for synthetic cohorts versus baseline. This is process RSS, not allocation-count or retained-heap proof.

limitations: Finite samples on one managed Linux host; results do not establish a universal performance guarantee.
Public semantic fixtures and synthetic inputs do not substitute for the private real-world corpus.
Four requested worker threads and four affinity IDs are not evidence of four physical cores or a particular CPU quota.
Compiler matches the pinned nightly, but the shared linker fallback to GNU ld differs from default-lld environments.
No cold-cache, API-only, allocation-count or private-corpus performance claim.

The candidate/exhaustive-reference comparison isolates indexed candidate enumeration; the baseline/candidate comparison also includes the architecture extraction and nested arithmetic matching change.
The new compiled nested-select recovery is separately exercised by the compact-style integration fixture; the broad default-style corpus remains byte-identical.

/proc/self/exe is unavailable. Profiler export/API self-hashing and certain cache/subprocess tests cannot run normally; root separately reproduced the same 12 binary-test failures on pristine baseline.

reproduction.prerequisites: Run from the candidate repository root on Linux with git,bash,python3,taskset,cmake,a C++ compiler and the pinned Rust nightly. Choose new BENCH_WORK,LUAU_SOURCE,LUAU_BUILD paths. Run no other heavy workloads. Select allowed CPU affinity IDs via DEINLINE_ONE_CPU and DEINLINE_MANY_CPUS; defaults match this measurement.
reproduction.memory_sampling: Repeat each native binary 5 times per cohort and worker count, alternating baseline,next,reference and reverse order. Use generated synthetic/input and semantic/in directories. Store output per label/cohort/worker count; do not mix memory sampling with timing.
